title: Interest Rate After Maturity on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Payoff Quotes
content:
**Rate note — quote interest after maturity.** On a customer payoff quote for a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, each quote interest day after the maturity date is charged at a daily rate set by the contract's most recent maturity election:

| Most recent maturity election | Recorded at least 30 calendar days before the maturity date | Daily rate for each quote interest day after maturity |
|---|---|---|
| Refinance | Yes | The principal balance times the refinance APR for the contract's tier (from the balloon refinance terms schedule) divided by 100 divided by the day basis, rounded to the cent |
| Return the vehicle | Yes | Nothing (0) |
| Refinance or return the vehicle | No | The per diem |
| Pay the balloon, or no election | — | The per diem |

The per diem is the daily simple interest at the contract's own APR stated on the quote.

**Which election.** The most recent maturity election is the one with the latest recorded date; of two maturity elections recorded the same day, the one recorded first is taken as the most recent. Calendar days from the election date to the maturity date count the maturity date and not the election date.

## Hypothetical cases (maturity on the 31st)

- Return election recorded on the 1st (30 days before), no later election: days after maturity are charged at nothing.
- Refinance election recorded on the 5th (26 days before): days after maturity are charged at the per diem.
- Refinance election on the 1st, then a pay-the-balloon election on the 10th: the most recent is pay the balloon, so the per diem.
- Refinance election on the 1st, no later election, principal balance USD 10,950.00, tier refinance APR 8.00%, 365-day basis: each day after maturity is charged USD 2.40 (10,950.00 times 8.00 divided by 100 divided by 365).
